title: An incomplete plan and living pleasure

captions.physics: Ending a plan with unsound foundations
captions.energy: Demanding a complete replacement leisure script

meaning: Leisure can remain alive when rejecting an unworkable plan permits an incomplete replacement and naturally changing responses from both.
text: After rejecting a failed plan, assembling another whole programme immediately can feel necessary. The Tower in the physical position of Svadhisthana describes ending a scheme with an unsound basis. The World in energy leans towards a complete replacement. The Wheel of Fortune in emotions allows interest, frustration, calm and renewed enthusiasm to alternate. Mood need not become even at once. Both may choose a small available pleasure without obliging the entire evening to form another faultless finished picture after the earlier one breaks.

For example, a day of museums turns into racing between addresses. You abandon the list but want another route to restore richness immediately. **A living evening can continue without a complete new programme.** Choosing one courtyard café and lingering permits calm conversation after frustration. Both retain different paces and later adjustments. A short pleasant moment need not compensate for everything unseen or continually maintain the initial excitement.

The difficulty is reading changing mood as evidence of insufficient replacement. You add items and hurry leisure again. The old false condition returns under another name: everything must be covered. A living uneven response permits pauses. Calling a small experience sufficient forbids no continuation. It leaves both free to choose later through actual interest instead of restoring lost completeness immediately through a predetermined quantity of impressions.
